description: This file defines the class 'ParamRuleCollection', which is a collection class used for managing parameter validation rules in API request handling within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties and methods for adding, removing, and retrieving validation rules, as well as handling exclusion keys and strict validation mode.

classes.name: ParamRuleCollection
classes.description: A collection class for managing parameter validation rules, supporting addition, removal, and retrieval of rules, as well as configuration options like strictness and excluded keys.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection with optional ParamRule objects.

methods.name: getParamValidations
methods.description: Returns all ParamRule objects in the collection.

methods.name: setParamValidations
methods.description: Replaces the current set of ParamRules with a new array of rules.

methods.name: addParamValidation
methods.description: Adds a ParamRule to the collection, throws exception if a rule for the same parameter key already exists.

methods.name: removeParamValidation
methods.description: Removes and returns a ParamRule by its parameter key, or null if not found.

methods.name: isStrict
methods.description: Returns whether the collection is in strict validation mode.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of parameter validation rules.

methods.name: getExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter keys excluded from validation.

methods.name: setExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Sets the list of parameter keys to be excluded from validation.

methods.name: addExcludedParamKey
methods.description: Adds a key to the list of excluded parameter keys.
